spatialGeneExpressionPyramid.name: label
spatialGeneExpressionPyramid.documentation: A human-readable label for this pyramid (e.g. 'Opossum V1 Stereo-seq').

spatialGeneExpressionPyramid.name: chip_serial
spatialGeneExpressionPyramid.documentation: The capture chip serial number, if the assay uses one. For Stereo-seq this is the SAW 'sn' field.

spatialGeneExpressionPyramid.name: pipeline_version
spatialGeneExpressionPyramid.documentation: The version of the primary analysis pipeline that produced the counts (e.g. 'SAW v7.1.2').

spatialGeneExpressionPyramid.name: bin_sizes
spatialGeneExpressionPyramid.documentation: Vector of the bin sizes present in this pyramid, in base pixel units, finest first (e.g. [1 5 10 20 50]). One spatialGeneExpressionTiles document exists per entry.

spatialGeneExpressionPyramid.name: base_pixel_size_x
spatialGeneExpressionPyramid.documentation: The physical size of one base (bin size 1) pixel in x, in pixel_size_units. For Stereo-seq at 500 nm DNB pitch this is 0.5.

spatialGeneExpressionPyramid.name: base_pixel_size_y
spatialGeneExpressionPyramid.documentation: The physical size of one base (bin size 1) pixel in y, in pixel_size_units.

spatialGeneExpressionPyramid.name: pixel_size_units
spatialGeneExpressionPyramid.documentation: The units of the pixel size, origin, and extent fields.

spatialGeneExpressionPyramid.name: origin_x
spatialGeneExpressionPyramid.documentation: The x coordinate of the upper-left corner of tile (0,0) in the source coordinate system (GEF minX for Stereo-seq). Required to register tiles against cell centroids, contours, and stain images.

spatialGeneExpressionPyramid.name: origin_y
spatialGeneExpressionPyramid.documentation: The y coordinate of the upper-left corner of tile (0,0) in the source coordinate system (GEF minY for Stereo-seq).

spatialGeneExpressionPyramid.name: extent_x
spatialGeneExpressionPyramid.documentation: The full width of the tiled region, in base pixel units.

spatialGeneExpressionPyramid.name: extent_y
spatialGeneExpressionPyramid.documentation: The full height of the tiled region, in base pixel units.

spatialGeneExpressionPyramid.name: tile_rows
spatialGeneExpressionPyramid.documentation: Number of tile rows, identical at every level, so tile (row,column) covers the same physical region at every bin size.

spatialGeneExpressionPyramid.name: tile_columns
spatialGeneExpressionPyramid.documentation: Number of tile columns, identical at every level.

spatialGeneExpressionPyramid.name: index_order
spatialGeneExpressionPyramid.documentation: How (row,column) maps to the suffix N in tile.bin_N. 'row-major': N = row*tile_columns + column. 'column-major': N = column*tile_rows + row.

spatialGeneExpressionPyramid.name: byte_order
spatialGeneExpressionPyramid.documentation: Byte order of multi-byte values in all binary files of this pyramid: 'little' or 'big'.
